entities.summary:
The Federation of Nigeria was a predecessor to modern-day Nigeria from 1954 to 1963. It was a British protectorate until its independence on 1 October 1960. The Federation consisted of three regions:Northern Region of Nigeria
Western Region of Nigeria
Eastern Region of Nigeria
